title: Checkout fails on mobile Safari
description: Users on iOS Safari 17+ cannot complete checkout. The 'Pay' button is unresponsive after entering card details. Reproduced on iPhone 14 and 15. Works fine on Chrome and desktop Safari.
comments: [CSM, May 20]: Two enterprise accounts (Northwind, $84k ARR) reported this today — they're escalating.

title: Password reset email never arrives
description: Users who request a password reset don't receive the email. Confirmed the request hits our backend but Resend shows no send event. Started after the email-template refactor on Monday.
comments: [Support, May 21]: 14 tickets in 2 days about this. Users locked out.

title: Invoice totals off by one cent on multi-line orders
description: On orders with 3+ line items, the invoice total is occasionally 1 cent higher than the sum of line items due to a rounding error in tax calculation. Finance flagged it during the monthly audit.
comments: [Finance, May 18]: This affects audited statements — accounting is not happy.

title: Dashboard chart colors slightly off-brand
description: The bar chart on the analytics dashboard uses #4A90D9 instead of our brand blue #3B82F6. Noticed during a design review.

title: Export to CSV times out for large accounts
description: Accounts with more than 10,000 records get a 504 when exporting to CSV. The export endpoint doesn't paginate or stream — it loads everything into memory.
comments: [Customer, May 19]: We can't get our quarterly data out. This is blocking our board report.

title: Login button misaligned by 2px on Firefox
description: The login button is shifted 2px to the right on Firefox compared to Chrome. Purely visual.

title: Webhook retries cause duplicate Slack notifications
description: When our webhook endpoint returns a 500, the upstream retries, and users get the same Slack notification 3-4 times. Need idempotency keys.

title: Search returns deleted records
description: The global search still surfaces records that were soft-deleted. Clicking them throws a 404. The search index isn't being updated on delete.

title: Checkout broken on iOS Safari
description: Mobile checkout doesn't work on iPhone. The pay button does nothing. Several customers complaining.

title: Session expires after 5 minutes instead of 24 hours
description: Users are being logged out every 5 minutes. The session TTL config was likely changed. Affecting everyone since this morning.
comments: [On-call, May 22]: Site-wide. Support queue is flooded.

title: Typo in onboarding welcome screen
description: The welcome screen says 'Wlecome to Acme' instead of 'Welcome to Acme'.

title: API rate limit headers missing
description: Our public API doesn't return X-RateLimit-* headers, so integrators can't tell how close they are to the limit. Feature request from a partner.

title: Profile photo upload fails silently
description: When a user uploads a profile photo over 5MB, nothing happens — no error, no upload. Should show a size-limit message.

title: Admin panel accessible without auth on staging
description: The /admin route on staging.acme.com loads without any authentication. Anyone with the URL can view all customer data. Found during a pen test.
comments: [Security, May 22]: Confirmed exploitable. Staging has a copy of prod data.

title: Notification preferences don't save
description: Toggling email notification preferences in settings appears to work but reverts on page reload. The PATCH request returns 200 but the value isn't persisted.

title: Dark mode flickers on page load
description: There's a brief flash of light theme before dark mode applies on initial page load. Minor but noticeable.

title: Billing page shows wrong currency for EU customers
description: EU customers see prices in USD instead of EUR on the billing page, even though their account locale is set to a European country. Could cause confusion at checkout.

title: Report generation occasionally produces blank PDF
description: Sometimes the generated PDF report is completely blank. Happens maybe 1 in 20 times. No pattern identified yet — can't reliably reproduce.
